name: Winnow
oneLiner: AI food waste management for commercial kitchens: a camera-and-scale bin system (Winnow Vision) that identifies and weighs discarded food, plus AI demand forecasting (Winnow Foresight) to cut overproduction.
bestFor: High-volume kitchens with significant production waste, such as hotel restaurants, buffets, contract caterers and large multi-site restaurant groups; less of a fit for small quick-service units with little prep waste.

updates.text: Launched Winnow Foresight, a mobile-first AI forecasting web app developed with Hilton chefs that predicts item-level kitchen demand from occupancy and past service data, with no extra hardware.
Acquired Singapore-based AI food waste company Lumitics to expand in Asia-Pacific and the Middle East; Lumitics customers gain access to Winnow's VisionAI.

features: Smart bin with camera and scale that automatically identifies and weighs thrown-away food (Winnow Vision)
'Throw and go' logging so staff don't have to tag items manually
Waste data by food item, shift and stage (prep, spoilage, plate waste) with cost values
Kitchen-facing screens that show staff what is being wasted and what it costs
Reports and dashboards for chefs and managers, with multi-site comparisons
AI demand forecasting by item and service to plan production (Winnow Foresight)
Lower-cost manual tracking option for sites that don't need computer vision

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Winnow does not publish prices.

notes: Fit: Winnow's named customers are mainly hotels, contract caterers and retailers' food courts (IKEA was an earlier client); it fits QSR only loosely. Dropped from the current review: 'the average restaurant wastes 4-10% of all food purchased' (no named source), 'kitchens cutting food waste by up to 50% within the first year' (vendor claim, unsourced), and Compass Group as a named client (not re-verified). The '$100M+ a year saved by hospitality customers' figure is a Winnow claim reported by Globetrender, Jan 2026. The IHG announcement date could not be confirmed (likely 2023). Winnow was Highly Commended at The Staff Canteen Members' Choice Awards 2026.
